snippet.title: Refuse: Home Sweep Home - PC Full Playthrough (Refuze: атака брака)
snippet.description:
Full walkthrough of a forgotten Russian PC game from 2006

Description from website:

The game “Refuse: home sweep home” is a fast-moving tactical fighter viewed from the 3rd person. The gamer is in charge of the group of three warriors, each having specific equipment and using unique weapon. The campain includes 15 levels. The gamer's mission is to sweep out the house and stop reproduction of plastic evil which been already started.

Translation Credits: GuyWithTeaCup
